evals.prompt: 为一套 7 页校园足球发布会模板规划 Nano Banana 配图。封面左侧放标题，右侧需要人物主视觉；章节页和愿景页也需要图，要求整套风格一致且正文可编辑。
evals.expected_output: A compact image-direction manifest using WebPPT fields, one reusable visual lock, correct slot-specific ratios and copy-safe regions, and no rasterized slide text or diagrams.

evals.prompt: 现有品牌十周年 PPT 的 AI 配图每页风格都不一样，封面人物还挡住了标题。请给出 Nano Banana 重生成方案，控制成本但保证最终 2K 质量。
evals.expected_output: A draft-select-final workflow with an accepted anchor reference, single-change retries, explicit title-safe composition, suite consistency rules, and 2K only for selected finals.

evals.prompt: 给 3:4 竖侧栏生成一张 STEAM 教育实验室配图，并说明你会如何验收它能安全嵌入 PPT，而不是单独看起来好看。
evals.expected_output: A subject-first prompt for the exact 3:4 panel crop plus QA against real slide placement, copy-safe area, no text/logo, edge integration, and technical format checks.
